Container.Name: Lucia-PostgreSQL
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL storage for Lucia configuration, traces, and tasks. Before installing, run `docker network create lucia` in the Unraid terminal. Install this template before Lucia.
Container.Requires: Before installing, run `docker network create lucia` in the Unraid terminal and install the supplied init.sql file as described in the Lucia Unraid readme.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: PostgreSQL data. Use a direct cache-pool path, not an array path.

Config.Name: Initialization
Config.Description: Directory containing the supplied init.sql file. PostgreSQL reads it only when creating a new data directory.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Use the same password in all three Lucia PostgreSQL connection strings.

Config.Name: Bootstrap database
Config.Description: Bootstrap database used while init.sql creates Lucia's databases.

Config.Name: Initialization options
Config.Description: Options used only when PostgreSQL creates a new data directory.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Optional host port for external database tools. Lucia does not need it.
